title: EDE fixed-endpoint sound-horizon response
faithful_claim: Eqs.(1)-(2) describe frozen-then-diluting energy; the paper claims lower r_s with a suitable perturbative fit.

equations.definitions: a0=1; ac transition scale; wn averaged post-transition equation of state. Omega_phi is not the instantaneous total-density fraction; fixed normalization needs source-code verification.
equations.domain: Paper effective-fluid background, finite-n oscillator or declared kinetic limit; no perturbation or CMB admission.

equations.locator: Sol proposed minimal test, derived from source Eqs. (1)-(2)
equations.definitions: Explicit physical density normalization; fc fraction at ac, not a peak fraction. Current density closure must be declared.
equations.domain: Proposed FLRW background toy test with positive densities and 0<=fc<1; not exact paper reproduction.

assumptions: Hubble-frozen initial scalar; potential proportional to (1-cos(phi/f))^n.
Effective-fluid averaging, initial angle and potential-dependent sound speed.
Potential linear initially and tends to zero.
Letter treats effective n→infinity limit, cs²=1; detailed potential deferred.

minimal_test.question: Necessary background sound-horizon response at a fixed, declared endpoint, not a CMB H0 solution.
observables: rho_phi,H,f_phi,r_s difference against matched zero-EDE control
minimal_test.scope: Identified physical densities, a0=1, transition a_c/f_c, fixed a_end and endpoint origin, physical units and density closure. No data hashes or priors supplied. All choices remain to be registered; no inferred values are inserted into a runnable request.

simplifications: Full scalar dynamics and oscillation averaging errors.
Potential-dependent EDE perturbation sound speed, metric/fluid coupling and CMB damping/peak response.
Self-consistent recombination/drag endpoint and fitted compensation in omega_cdm, ns, As,H0.
data_dependencies: Planck high-ℓ and low-ℓ TT, TE, EE plus lensing likelihood (Planck 2015 likelihood); neutrino model: two massless species and one massive species with Mν=0.06 eV.
SH0ES H0=73.52±1.62 km/s/Mpc; BAO: 6dFGS, SDSS MGS, BOSS DR12 (including fσ8); Pantheon 1048 SNe Ia over 0.01<z<2.3.
Inference uses modified CLASS and MontePython MCMC, stated flat priors and nuisance parameters; evidence uses MultiNest and lite high-ℓ likelihood.
unknowns: Exact source Omega normalization and full slow-roll potential.
Scalar/fluid validity domain and reference outputs.
verification_gates: Keep numerical verification, observation lineage, inference validation and scientific interpretation as separate gates.
Freeze reference cases and consumer-derived error allocations before accepting outputs; no production tolerance is invented here.
Historical fit values are comparison targets only after matching release, likelihood, priors and implementation.
Differentiate rho and verify continuity equation with Eq.(2). Check frozen and late-power-law limits, a→0 convergence and f_c→0 control.
Independent quadrature and unit/convention checks; distinguish photon-baryon c_gamma_b from EDE rest-frame cs.
Before CMB inference implement and validate perturbations, recombination and likelihoods; resolve source angular-ratio inconsistency.
falsification: At fixed densities/loading/endpoint a positive added rho must not increase r_s. Failure rejects the implementation or the stated background test assumptions, not all possible EDE cosmologies. A lower background r_s alone cannot pass the source claim of jointly acceptable CMB/BAO/SN fits.

consumer.capability_status: No compiled EDE, NEDE or timescape model at inspected revision; all listed scientific capabilities unqualified.

blockers: Current sound-horizon function fixes a radiation+matter+Lambda expansion and accepts no EDE density parameters.
No compiled EDE model, scalar/perturbation or recombination solver, CMB likelihood or recipe runner.

qualification.reason: Source/design review only. No compiled model, admitted data, numerical run or paper reproduction.
